channel.title: Korea Plainly: guides
channel.description: Plain-English guides for first-time visitors to Korea.

item.title: Do You Tip in Korea? What Visitors Should Know
item.description: Tipping is not a normal part of everyday service in Korea. Learn what to expect at restaurants, in taxis, at hotels, and on tours—and what to do if a tip is requested.

item.title: New Year Sunrise in Korea: Where to Watch the First Sunrise
item.description: Where to see the first sunrise of the year in Korea on 1 January: east coast beaches, Jeju and Seoul hilltops, sunrise times, getting there and staying warm.

item.title: Seoul or Busan? How to Choose (or Do Both) on Your First Trip
item.description: Seoul vs Busan for first-time visitors: what each city is like, sights, food, beaches, costs and weather, how to split your days, and getting between them by KTX.

item.title: Korea in March: Weather, What to Pack and What to Do
item.description: Visiting Korea in March: how cold it still is, what to wear, the first plum and cherry blossoms in the south, fine dust, holidays and what to do.

item.title: Korea in October: Weather, What to Pack and What to Do
item.description: Visiting Korea in October: crisp autumn weather, the first autumn leaves, the film festival in Busan, fireworks in Seoul, lantern and mask festivals, and public holidays.

item.title: Korean Phrases Cheat Sheet: A Printable Page for Your Trip
item.description: A one-page printable Korean cheat sheet for travellers: greetings, restaurant and café phrases, menu words, getting around, shopping and help, in Hangul with easy pronunciation.

item.title: Korea in November: Weather, What to Pack and What to Do
item.description: Visiting Korea in November: how cold it gets, what to wear, the last autumn leaves, kimchi-making season, lantern and fireworks festivals, and the exam day that stops planes.

item.title: Best Night Views in Seoul: Where to See the City Lights
item.description: Where to see Seoul at night: N Seoul Tower, the old city wall at Naksan Park, Seoul Sky, Han River bridges, Cheonggyecheon and more, with tips on timing and getting there.

item.title: Cherry Blossom in Korea 2027: When and Where to See It
item.description: When cherry blossom is expected in Korea in 2027, from Jeju and Busan in late March to Seoul in early April, the best places to see it and how to plan around the crowds.

item.title: How Much Does a Trip to Korea Cost? A Daily Budget Guide
item.description: A plain daily budget for Korea: what hotels, food, transport and sights cost, three sample budgets from backpacker to comfortable, and easy ways to save.

item.title: How to Ride the KTX: Booking Korea's High-Speed Trains
item.description: A practical guide to booking KTX tickets, choosing the right station and seat, and finding your train on travel day.

item.title: Korea in December: Weather, What to Pack and What to Do
item.description: Visiting Korea in December: how cold it gets, what to wear, Christmas lights, the Seoul lantern festival, the first ski days and New Year's Eve at Bosingak bell.

item.title: Korea in January: Weather, What to Pack and What to Do
item.description: Visiting Korea in January: the coldest month, what to wear, ice fishing festivals, skiing, snowy palaces and how to stay warm, with tips for New Year's Day.

item.title: Korea in February: Weather, Seollal and What to Do
item.description: Visiting Korea in February: still cold but warming up, Lunar New Year (Seollal) on 6-9 February 2027, the last ski weeks, snow festivals and early signs of spring in the south.

item.title: Korea's Winter Festivals: Ice Fishing, Snow and Lights
item.description: The best winter festivals in Korea for visitors: Hwacheon's trout ice fishing, Pyeongchang, Taebaek's snow sculptures, Seoul's lantern festival and winter light gardens, with how to get there.

item.title: 7 Days in Korea: A First-Timer's Itinerary (Seoul, Gyeongju, Busan)
item.description: A one-week Korea itinerary for first-time visitors: three days in Seoul, a day trip, ancient Gyeongju and the beaches of Busan, linked by fast KTX trains, with a Jeju alternative.

item.title: 10 Days to 2 Weeks in Korea: An Easy Itinerary
item.description: A 10-day Korea itinerary for first-time visitors: Seoul, Jeonju's hanok village, Gyeongju, Busan and Jeju, with how to stretch it to two weeks with the east coast and Seoraksan.

item.title: 5 Days in Seoul: A Relaxed Itinerary for First-Timers
item.description: Five days in Seoul for first-time visitors: palaces and hanok lanes, markets and Namsan, Hongdae and the Han River, Gangnam and Jamsil, and a day trip to the DMZ or Suwon.

item.title: First Trip to Korea? Start Here: A Step-by-Step Planner
item.description: Planning your first trip to Korea, step by step: when to go, how long to stay, entry rules, money, phones, getting from the airport, getting around and what to know on the ground.

item.title: Learn to Read Hangul in an Hour: Korean Alphabet for Travellers
item.description: Learn to read the Korean alphabet before your trip: every letter with its sound, how syllable blocks work, a read-the-sign quiz and a memory game, with real words from Korean signs and menus.

item.title: Korea Packing List: What to Bring in Every Season (Interactive Checklist)
item.description: An interactive packing list for Korea: pick your season and tick off documents, money, phone and apps, clothes, health and handy extras. Your ticks are saved, and you can print it.

item.title: Korea Trip Cost Calculator: How Much Will Your Trip Cost?
item.description: Work out a rough budget for your trip to Korea: choose how many days, your travel style, KTX trains and a Jeju flight, and see the cost per person in won and your own currency.

item.title: Which Korean City Suits You? Take the Quiz
item.description: Seoul, Busan, Jeju, Gyeongju, Jeonju or Gangneung? Answer five quick questions and Kkachi the magpie will tell you which Korean city fits your travel style, with a guide to plan the trip.

item.title: Festivals in Korea: What's On This Month and Coming Up
item.description: A festival calendar for Korea, updated every week: what is on now and coming up across the country, from food and lantern festivals to fireworks, flowers and ice fishing.

item.title: How to Eat Korean BBQ: A Step-by-Step Guide for Visitors
item.description: Learn what to order, how to cook the meat, and how to make a Korean BBQ wrap, with practical tips for your first visit.

item.title: Korea in Winter: What to Expect, Pack and Do
item.description: Visiting Korea in winter: how cold it gets, what to pack, skiing, ice festivals, Christmas lights, warming street food and what to watch out for.

item.title: Skiing in Korea: Resorts Near Seoul and How to Get There
item.description: When ski season runs in Korea, the best resorts near Seoul and in Gangwon, shuttle buses from the city, gear rental and lessons for beginners.

item.title: Christmas and New Year in Seoul: Lights, Bells and Sunrise
item.description: How Christmas is celebrated in Korea, where to see Seoul's Christmas lights, the Bosingak bell on New Year's Eve and where to watch the first sunrise.

item.title: Seollal 2027: Visiting Korea During Lunar New Year
item.description: Seollal falls on 7 February 2027, with a holiday from 6 to 9 February. What happens, what closes, how transport is affected and tips for visitors.
